plan.title: PRIVACY.md and the charter claim the app is offline; it is not

metadata.spec: Plugin Architecture D8 depends on this

narratives.Overview: `PRIVACY.md` and the ViLM application charter both describe the app as offline and zero-network. Neither is accurate today, and the gap predates any current work.
narratives.Problem:
`PRIVACY.md` states:

> ViLM does not collect, store, transmit, or share any of your personal data.

> ViLM does not require an internet connection to function. The only time ViLM interacts with external networks is if you explicitly click an external web link that you manually added.

**Both statements are inaccurate.** `ProfileImageView.swift:190` and `EntityProfileEditorView.swift:660` download profile images from stored URLs with a browser User-Agent, **automatically on profile view** — no click involved.

Measured on the live library: **550 of 1,160 stored photo URLs (47%) contain the actor's name in the path**, e.g. `https://<host>/pics/<Actor Name>2.jpg`. So which performers are catalogued already reaches third-party hosts, one at a time, triggered by scrolling.

The application charter repeats the claim, describing the app as '100% private and offline' with 'zero-network local storage'.
narratives.Action:
Correct the wording to describe what the app actually does. Specifically:

- State that profile images are fetched from URLs stored on the actor record, automatically when a profile is displayed, and that a URL may contain the actor's name.
- Drop 'does not transmit any of your personal data' or qualify it precisely.
- Drop 'only when you explicitly click a link'.
- Keep what remains TRUE and is the real privacy story: the catalogue, thumbnails, contact sheets and profiles are stored locally; there is no analytics, no tracking, no crash reporting; nothing is uploaded.

Distinguish the **default build** (local-only apart from image loading) from a build with optional components linked, so the statement stays true as the plugin architecture lands.
narratives.Constraint:
Do not overcorrect. The app genuinely is local-first and genuinely has no analytics; a rewrite that reads as alarming would misrepresent it in the other direction.

Every remaining claim must be verifiable from the code.
narratives.Risk: No functional risk — documentation only. The risk of NOT doing it is that a published privacy statement is wrong, and the Plugin Architecture epic (D8) explicitly depends on this correction landing: shipping plugins on top of an inaccurate statement compounds the problem.
narratives.Test: Read the changed wording against the code paths cited above; every claim must be checkable.
narratives.Source: Found while assessing the in-app enrichment button for the Actor Metadata Enrichment spec (recorded there as E6). Independent of that work and of the plugin epic; it is wrong today.

items.title: PRIVACY.md no longer claims network access happens only on an explicit link click
PRIVACY.md no longer claims the app transmits none of the user's data
The application charter's '100% private and offline' and 'zero-network' wording is corrected
Wording distinguishes the DEFAULT build (local-only) from a build with optional components linked
No claim is made that cannot be verified from the code
